ranking.title: How ranking works
ranking.lead: Explore lists only opportunities organizations made visible to you, in one of two orders you choose. No organization can pay for placement.
ranking.factor1: The application deadline: the soonest deadline comes first, so you never miss one.
ranking.factor2: The start date: among equal deadlines, the work that starts first comes first.
ranking.visibility: You see an opportunity only when the organization made it visible to you: by invitation, through its talent or vendor pools, to people who completed work with it, or to the whole marketplace.
ranking.filters: Your filters narrow the list; they never reorder it.
ranking.recommendedLead: Each opportunity gets a score out of 100 from your own profile. Nothing an organization pays for counts.

skills.title: Skills, up to {points} points.
skills.body: Full points when the opportunity's category is one of your profile skills, 25 when it is in the same discipline, and 10 when it is in the same department.

certifications.title: Certifications, up to {points} points.
certifications.body: The share of required certifications you hold, on a current organization record or listed on your profile with the same name. An opportunity that requires none has nothing missing. The organization still checks certifications during onboarding.

location.title: Location, up to {points} points.
location.body: When you search near a place: full points within 50 km and 10 within 150 km. Otherwise: full points when the venue is in your profile's city, 5 when it is in your country.

availability.title: Availability, up to {points} points.
availability.body: Full points when none of your unavailable days fall on the work dates, half when the opportunity has no dates yet.

ranking.ties: Equal scores keep the soonest deadline first, then the earliest start.
ranking.never: Payment, plan, ads or anything else an organization pays for. Your protected characteristics. Who passed on or saved an opportunity.
ranking.passed: Opportunities you pass on leave your results until you undo the pass. Organizations never see who passed.

account.name: Full name
account.oneAccount: This one account works in Gateway, Atlas and Compass for every organization.

security.passwordless: Gateway signs you in with an email link or your connected provider first; a password is optional. Each device keeps its own session.

organizations.none: You do not belong to a company account. Create one below if you work as a company.

company.profileUnavailable: The company profile is managed by the organization's Atlas administrators. Ask an Account Owner to set it up.
company.inviteNote: An invited person signs in to Gateway with the address you invited and accepts on Home. Until then they are not rostered or assigned, and nothing about them is shared.

notes.regions: Service regions and capabilities are part of your company profile.
notes.dangerZone: Transferring ownership or closing a company account is done with platform support so records the law requires are kept. The last Account Owner cannot leave.

notifications.saved: Saved. New notifications follow these choices.

calendarFeeds.title: Calendar feeds
calendarFeeds.description: Subscribe from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook to see your published shifts and the meetings, milestones and deadlines shared with you, across every organization you work with. Calendars refresh it about once an hour.
calendarFeeds.secret: Anyone with a feed's link can read it, so keep the link private. If it gets out, get a new link or revoke the feed.

calendarFeeds.revokeConfirm: The link stops working at once and cannot be turned back on.
calendarFeeds.linkHelp: Copy the link now. It is shown only once; after you leave this page you can only get a new one.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.help: Push notifications from organizations you are not a member of wait until your quiet hours end. Safety alerts, changes to your sign-in security, a recovery code used on your account and a new or changed shift starting within 12 hours still reach you. Email is never held.
quietHours.saved: Saved. Pushes wait out these hours.

diversity.lead: Optional and self-declared. Each certification is shared only with an organization you choose that runs a supplier diversity program, by separate consent you can revoke here at any time.
diversity.noPrograms: None of the organizations you work with or applied to runs a supplier diversity program yet.
